about: RL-53 W-6 / RL-108 condition 6: the magistrate watchdog's states and transitions as bound data.

The watchdog re-decides every tick from the world (plans, locks, process table, clocks, STOP), not from its previous state, so every state in tick_targets is a legal successor of every declared state.
States that only the resident supervisor enters (supervisor_edges) are legal only from the states in which a supervised session can exist.
An undeclared state or edge never blocks a transition: the watchdog records an undeclared_transition event and queues one safety notice. Its own safety logic stays authoritative.

unsafe_holds keep the existing UNSAFE_HOLD_DWELL_S -> STRANDED rule. timing_holds are the states _hold_boundaries opens a hold span for. dwell_limits_s applies only to states that are not unsafe holds; expiry queues one notice per episode and changes no state, fence, launch or signal.
chain_open_past_completion: an open chain keeps a plan span active with no clock limit; past the limit the fence stays and one notice is queued.

supervisor_edges.writer: ResidentSupervisor._step -> _enforce_drain (STOP file or remote stop ref)

LAUNCHING.basis: LAUNCH_LIVENESS_S (900): the bound the watchdog already gives a launch to leave a record

ACTIVE.basis: no session ceiling exists in code; one day of continuous ACTIVE without a clean exit or stand-down is reported. Liveness within it stays W-02 (HEARTBEAT_STALE_S, stream growth). Open question for the research lead.

IDLE.basis: clean-exit cooldown 300 s (_finish_child next_eligible) + one launchd StartInterval (300 s, LAUNCHD_START_INTERVAL_S)

BACKOFF_USAGE.basis: max(USAGE_BACKOFF_S) 7200 + max jitter_for_activation 120 + one launchd StartInterval 300

STANDDOWN_KILL.basis: KILL_LEAD_S (60, kill to t0) + one launchd StartInterval 300

chain_open_past_completion.basis: plan_completion_epoch(plan) = t0_epoch_s + window_max_s + COURIER_DEADLINE_S, the end of the window and its courier deadline; a chain still open after it keeps the span (and the fence) active with no clock limit
